title: Coordinated hit job on Malmgren after Jesse's interview

tellings.quote: was this hit job written about him where it was like I talked to an archivist and they had never heard of the guy

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that after he interviewed a man named Harold Malmgren, who spoke about a secret history touching figures such as the CIA official Richard Bissell and the wealthy Paul Mellon, a coordinated attack piece was written about him. According to Michels, it included claims, also on Malmgren's Wikipedia page, that an archivist had never heard of him. Michels tells it because he sees it as an effort to discredit a source who was talking about hidden matters.
